speakers.name: Anika Patel
speakers.title: Principal Engineer
speakers.bio: Core contributor to the React Compiler and co-author of the Concurrent Mode RFC. Anika has spent the last 6 years working on React's internals and loves making complex concurrency concepts accessible to everyday developers.

speakers.name: Marcus Chen
speakers.title: Staff Engineer
speakers.bio: Marcus helped build Next.js's App Router and has authored dozens of proposals for improving the React Server Components model. He's on a mission to make web performance boring (in the best way).
talks: The Next.js App Router: A Year In

speakers.name: Zara Okonkwo
speakers.title: TypeScript Team Lead
speakers.bio: Zara leads a sub-team on the TypeScript compiler with a focus on error messages people can actually understand. She's passionate about language design, DX, and ensuring TypeScript works as well for a 50-person startup as for a Fortune 500.
talks: Writing Error Messages Humans Can Read

speakers.name: Luca Ferretti
speakers.title: Open Source Engineer
speakers.bio: Luca maintains three widely-used open-source CLI tools and has merged PRs from contributors in 47 countries. He's deeply passionate about first-contributor experiences and has spoken at 12 conferences about sustainable OSS maintenance.

speakers.name: Priya Subramaniam
speakers.title: Distinguished Engineer
speakers.bio: Priya has been running Kubernetes in production since version 1.2. She led Google's internal effort to move 10,000+ services to GKE and now helps the community understand what enterprise-scale Kubernetes operations actually looks like day-to-day.

speakers.name: Jordan Rivers
speakers.title: Security Research Lead
speakers.bio: Jordan is a security researcher who specializes in finding vulnerabilities in developer tooling — CI pipelines, supply chain attacks, and the scary stuff hiding in your node_modules. They've disclosed 30+ CVEs and love making security understandable for non-security engineers.
talks: Your CI Pipeline is a Target

speakers.name: Amara Diallo
speakers.title: ML Platform Architect
speakers.bio: Amara builds the systems that help ML researchers get models into production without losing their minds. She's co-authored three papers on model evaluation methodology and is one of the loudest voices arguing that benchmark leaderboards are actively harmful.
talks: Why Benchmarks Are Lying to You
